text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! You'll find out once we get
there. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's Valentine's Day, and for some
reason, Satono
Diamond has suddenly
decided to take me
somewhere. The
place we arrive is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nowhere special. We're just standing
outside
Ritto Dorm. However, an
unfamiliar device sits in
front of the
entrance.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe! This is your Valentine's surprise!
choice_data_list: あのクレーンや箱の山は何！？

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I've prepared an extra, extra large claw machine for you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The rules are the same as a regular claw
machine
except a person is suspended
from the crane and
has to grab the
prizes themselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In other words, someone will have to act
as the
claw.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I thought it'd be fun to surprise you for

Valentine's Day, so I did quite a bit of
research
looking for ideas.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's when I came across an article
about a
company affiliated with the
Satono Group that
used a giant claw
machine during an event!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It looked like so much fun, I went and
borrowed
the machine along with some
staff to help
operate it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The prizes are Valentine's chocolates!
I've
prepared many different varieties, so
go ahead
and take the ones you like!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've included everything from
inexpensive
chocolates to limited
edition chocolates made by
famous
chocolatiers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The staff will operate the crane for you.
Just tell
them in which direction you
want to move! ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right! You get to be the claw!
I hope
you enjoy my special Valentine's
Day gift!
choice_data_list: もしかして、アーム役は……

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't have expected anything less
from
Satono Diamond, with her curiosity
and rich
imagination. As her trainer, I
have no choice but
to participate!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Traaainer! Please shout out the direction
you
want to go!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay!
Lower it down carefully, please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The claw operator is so skilled at
handling the
machine, I don't feel scared
at all as I'm lowered
toward the
mountain of chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I'm starting to have a lot of fun! I
reach
out for the chocolate surrounding
me and fill my
arms to maximum
capacity.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You're quite good at this! Your
sense of
balance is fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to go for one more
round? Be
careful not to drop any!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! You're completely absorbed in
the game!
I'm so glad you're enjoying
yourself! ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Brilliant performance, Trainer! I couldn't
stop
watching you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But more importantly, it looked like you
had a lot
of fun.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Great! ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to share even more fun
experiences with
you. Both on and off
the track.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, the chocolates! You won them
fair and
square, so feel free to tuck in!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I plan to eat some chocolate and
reminisce about
the day after I get back
too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No doubt I'll remember her smile every
day as I
slowly work through the massive
amount of
chocolates I won from the
claw machine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I'm starting to have a lot of fun! I
scoop
up an armful of the chocolates
surrounding me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh! That one is, um...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The wrapping on one of the boxes is a
little messy
and looks hand-wrapped. I
reach for it, losing my
balance in the
process.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer! Please don't push yourself too
hard!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, you dropped your other
chocolates...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Could it be that... you noticed?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My haul from the claw machine is
impressive.
Above all else, I manage to
snag the box with the
slightly misshapen
wrapping!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That one, um... It contains chocolates I
made
myself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So you went out of your way to get it
because
you realized I made it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Geez...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Please, go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I unwrap the box, pluck out one of the
beautifully
placed chocolates, and take
a bite.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm puzzled by the curious taste that fills
my
senses. It's not that it's bad—I would
even say
that it's tasty—but I can't place
the flavor.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Does it taste strange?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I had a feeling that might be the case... I
wanted
to try giving the chocolate a
unique flavor, but
they turned out a bit
funny...
choice_data_list: 美味しいけれど、不思議な味……

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I didn't think they were terrible when I
sampled
them, but I honestly wasn't sure
if they were good
enough to give to
you...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for trying them! You
don't
need to eat them all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: このチョコに合う味を探してみない？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel that pairing the chocolates with
another
flavor will make them taste
better, so I suggest
eating them with
other food.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see. So you think we should search for

something that will complement it, like
another
snack or some fruit?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That sounds fun! Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We try eating the chocolates with all
kinds of
different things in an attempt to
come up with a
tasty combination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we find that Satono
Diamond's
homemade chocolates go
best with dragonfruit.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. We've created a one-of-a-kind
chocolate
experience, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even though it tastes fantastic, I won't
tell a soul
about this combination. It'll
be our little secret. ♪
